name: 曾釋鋒
objective:
本課程涵蓋半導體產業趨勢發展、超大型 (Giga) 半導體工廠廠務系統與先進自動化工廠運作、以及先進半導體製程技術和設備等三大部分。
This course mainly consists of development trend, Giga FAB, FAB automation, and processing technology and equipment for advanced semiconductor manufacturing.

延伸教學與資源:
● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
